## err.card
The error workflow every card flow points to (settings.errorWorkflow). A card flow whose node throws (missing input, failed call) with no BLOCKED path would otherwise leave the card silently in its list.
Trigger: Error Trigger (production executions only). The payload names the failed execution, flow, node and error, but not the card.

## How it finds the card
1. Failure: execution id, flow, failing node, message.
2. Card flow failure?: stops on a loop (this flow or cap.kanban_coach.handle_error failed) or a payload with no execution id; that branch only logs.
3. Read execution (n8n Workflows API, includeData): the failed run.
4. Resolve card: card_id/board_id/list/card_type from its Flow object, else its Webhook query+body, else its From another workflow input. No card id => not a card flow => zero items, stop.

## Exit
Resolve project (RM by board) -> Blocked list (planka_list_ids.BLOCKED) -> Move to BLOCKED -> Comment [BLOCKED/flow_error] <flow> · <node> · <message> (conveyor Planka user) -> Coach block (flow_error): cap.kanban_coach.handle_error, fire-and-forget (options.waitForSubWorkflow=false), block_text = node: message.
